_about: Regular expressions the mod matches against Hypixel text. Copy this file to config/sbcompanion/patterns/ to override entries without rebuilding; use /sbc reload.
Party.NAME: (?:\[[^\]]+\] )?(\w{3,16}) ●
Party.LEFT: ^(?:\[[^\]]+\] )?(\w{3,16}) (?:has left the party|has been removed from the party|was removed from your party|disconnected, they have 5 minutes to rejoin before they are removed from the party)\.?$
_source_Compact: Compact.POTION_* = SkyHanni features/chat/CompactSplashPotionMessage.kt potionEffectPatternList; Compact.BESTIARY_* = CompactBestiaryChatMessage.kt; Compact.RANK_* = playerchat/PlayerChatModifier.kt
Compact.POTION_0: §a§lBUFF! §fYou were splashed by (?<playerName>.*) §fwith §r(?<effectName>.*)§r§f! Press TAB or type /effects to view your active effects!
Compact.POTION_1: §a§lBUFF! §fYou have gained §r(?<effectName>.*)§r§f! Press TAB or type /effects to view your active effects!
Compact.POTION_2: §a§lBUFF! §fYou splashed yourself with §r(?<effectName>.*)§r§f! Press TAB or type /effects to view your active effects!
